context: Tests whether prose cleanup removes filler and repeated scaffolding while preserving facts, commands, numbers, structure, and author voice.

checklist.name: Punctuation serves the prose
checklist.description: Removes repetitive punctuation scaffolding where it makes prose awkward; does not mechanically ban useful em dashes or replace them with equally repetitive punctuation.

checklist.name: Stock vocabulary gone
checklist.description: Words like robust, seamless/seamlessly, cutting-edge, leverages, crucial, delves, empowers, unlock, paradigm shift, and landscape no longer appear

checklist.name: Filler and hedging cut
checklist.description: Phrases like 'it's worth noting', 'it should be noted', 'in today's fast-paced world', 'may potentially be considered', and the 'In conclusion' section are removed rather than rephrased into new filler

checklist.name: Vague attribution resolved
checklist.description: 'Studies show' is either replaced with a named source or the claim is deleted; it does not survive as an unsourced appeal

checklist.name: Inline-header list reworked
checklist.description: The '**Blazing Fast:**'-style bolded-label feature list is rewritten as plain prose or plain bullets without the bold-label crutch

checklist.name: Facts and commands intact
checklist.description: The 120,000 lines/second figure, both commands (curl install and streamlog init --port 5140), and the Linux/macOS support statement survive exactly; no facts are added or dropped

checklist.name: Meaning preserved
checklist.description: The cleaned text makes the same claims as the original (fast single-core throughput, integrations, at-least-once delivery, no Windows plans); this is a phrasing pass, not a rewrite of substance

checklist.name: Not over-cleaned
checklist.description: Preserves the original Title Case headings, including Key Features and Getting Started, and the author's concrete factual voice without adding opinions or mannerisms.
